program_id.title: Program Identifier
program_id.description: Program identifier in the pismo platform.

attach_datetime.title: Attach Date
attach_datetime.description: The date and time when the program was attached.

detach_datetime.title: Detach datetime
detach_datetime.description: Detach datetime. This field appears as null during attach events and is populated only during detach events.

metadata.title: Custom fields
metadata.description: This field is used to propagate information not directly related to the transactional flow. It's in the key-value pair format and is not handled by Pismo

interest_capitalization_mode.title: Interest Capitalization Mode
interest_capitalization_mode.description: Program-level capitalization mode carried by the attachment. `REINVEST` (default) or `PAYOUT`.

effective_date.title: Effective Date
effective_date.description: The effective date of the attachment. The format is `YYYY-MM-DD`.

maturity_period.title: Maturity period
maturity_period.description: Resolved maturity period for the attachment. The event always includes the fully resolved state (unit, value, and `calendar_maturity_date`). When the request omits maturity data, IBA‑API applies the product default, so this object is always populated.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Time unit of the maturity period. Used internally for rollover.

value.title: Value
value.description: Number of time units until maturity (>= 1). Used internally for rollover.

calendar_maturity_date.title: Calendar maturity date
calendar_maturity_date.description: Effective maturity date. The format is `YYYY-MM-DD`.

maturity_instructions.title: Maturity Instructions
maturity_instructions.description: Instructions on what to do with funds once maturity date is reached

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: Specifies the action applied to the principal at maturity. Supported options are `PAY` and `ROLLOVER`.

interest.title: Interest
interest.description: How interest funds are processed once the maturity date is reached. It can be either `PAY` or `ROLLOVER`

overrides.title: Attachment overrides
overrides.description: A saved record of the per‑attachment overrides applied on top of the product defaults. This object appears only when at least one override was provided, and each field is included only if it was explicitly set. At program level, only `renewal_term` is permitted; `maturity_instructions` and penalties are not accepted by IBA‑API and therefore never included.

renewal_term_override.title: Renewal term override
renewal_term_override.description: Recurring rollover term, not the same as the initial `maturity_period`. The response reflects the structure of the request. If the client supplies `unit` and `value`, those fields appear in the response. If the client supplies `renewal_calendar_maturity_date`, the response returns that date as a string..

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Time unit of the renewal term.

renewal_calendar_maturity_date.title: Renewal calendar maturity date
renewal_calendar_maturity_date.description: Returned only when the request uses the calendar format. Format = `YYYY-MM-DD`.

product_id.title: Product Identifier
product_id.description: Pismo product identifier in UUID v4 format

name.title: Product Name
name.description: Name given to the product by the customer

interest_plan_id.title: Interest Plan Identifier
interest_plan_id.description: Pismo interest plan identifier in UUID v4 format

term_type.title: Term Type
term_type.description: Type of deposit product term, it can be either `FIXED` or `FLEXIBLE`

created_at.title: Creation datetime
created_at.description: Deposit product creation date time. Represented as a RFC3339 timestamp.

cool_off_period.title: Cool Off Period
cool_off_period.description: Period in days during which withdrawals are allowed without penalties

funding_duration.title: Funding Duration
funding_duration.description: Period in days during which funds are allowed to be deposited into the account before operations are blocked

updated_at.title: Update Datetime
updated_at.description: Deposit product last update date time. Represented as a RFC3339 timestamp

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Deposit product start date. The format is `YYYY-MM-DD`.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Deposit product end date. The format is `YYYY-MM-DD`.

early_withdrawal_after_opening.title: Early withdrawal after opening
early_withdrawal_after_opening.description: Penalty applied when withdrawing shortly after opening.

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: How many days after opening the penalty becomes applicable.

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty.

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty.

tiered_interest_forfeiture.title: Tiered interest forfeiture
tiered_interest_forfeiture.description: List of tier definitions for interest forfeiture.

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: How many days after a withdrawal a new withdrawal is treated as penalty-eligible.

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as the penalty amount.

window_behavior.title: Window behavior
window_behavior.description: Controls how the penalty window behaves after each withdrawal.

deposit_tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.title: Tiered interest forfeiture tier
deposit_tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.description: Single tier in the product-level tiered interest forfeiture configuration.

min_days_held.title: Min days held
min_days_held.description: Minimum number of days the deposit must be held for this tier to apply.

max_days_held.title: Max days held
max_days_held.description: Maximum number of days the deposit can remain in this tier.

forfeited_interest_days.title: Forfeited interest days
forfeited_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty for this tier.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Maturity notices configured for the product.

days_before_maturity.title: Days before maturity
days_before_maturity.description: Number of days before maturity when the notice is emitted.
